Subject: Redwood evaluation kickoff - next steps & calendar

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery: Acme is focused on integrating a document-to-action assistant for customer support triage and internal knowledge search. Your priorities are latency under 150ms for short prompts, tight relevance on retrieval-augmented generations, and clear per-call cost visibility.

Proposed next step: schedule an evaluation kickoff where we walk through the trial plan, align on success criteria, and finalize the prompt set/evals. I have these available windows next week (PDT):
- Tue 6/16 10:00–11:00am
- Wed 6/17 2:00–3:00pm
- Thu 6/18 9:00–10:00am

If none of those work, send a few times that do and we’ll accommodate. For the kickoff, it would be helpful to have your product manager and a security/SRE contact on the call so we can cover networking and data controls.

I attached a short evaluation playbook and a starter prompt set for you to review before the call. Agenda suggestion: 1) review goals & success criteria (15m), 2) trial plan & timelines (15m), 3) technical deep-dive plan & resources (20m), 4) Q&A / next steps (10m).

Notes/asks:
- Please confirm preferred time and who from your team will join (PM, SRE/security).
- Share any existing prompt examples or datasets you want us to include in the first eval run.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this scheduled.

Connor O'Brien
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
connor_obrien@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0113

Connor —

Thanks for the recap and the materials. Great summary.

We can do Wed 6/17 2:00–3:00pm PDT. Priya (PM) and I will join; I also asked Sofia (SRE/security) to join so we can cover network/access questions.

High-level success criteria from our side:
- Retrieval relevance: 75%+ precision on top-3 retrievals for our support KB prompts
- Latency: median inference latency under 150ms for single-turn user prompts (expected seq lengths ~50–150 tokens)
- Cost: comparable or better token/unit economics than our current provider for the same quality band

We also have a few example prompts and a sanitized sample of support tickets. I can share a Drive folder with those before Monday.

One quick question: will the kickoff include a short demo of Redwood's routing/fallback behavior for capacity constraints? If so, great — otherwise we can schedule a separate technical deep-dive.

For the kickoff prep, attaching the eval playbook and the prompt set we discussed. Action items for your team before the call:
